title: KYEM Email: WebEOC Password Reset Sat 12/12

fields.to: County Emergency Management Directors (KYEM statewide distribution)
fields.subject: ROUTINE: Statewide WebEOC password reset Sat 12/12 06:00–10:00 ET
fields.body:
County EM Directors,

Kentucky WebEOC will be down for scheduled maintenance on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 06:00 to 10:00 ET (05:00 to 09:00 CT). Do not enter situation reports or resource requests during that window. If you need the state during the outage, use the KYEM duty officer line.

After maintenance, every county account will have to set a new password at its first login. New passwords must be at least 14 characters long. Accounts that have not been reset by Saturday, December 19 will be locked and must be unlocked by the helpdesk.

Please pass this on to your deputies and to anyone else in your county with a WebEOC account.

If you have questions, call the KYEM helpdesk at 502-555-0142.

No action is required tonight.

Thank you,
fields.signature:
WebEOC Administrator
Kentucky Emergency Management
Information Systems Branch
webeoc-admin@kyem-portal.example | Helpdesk 502-555-0142
fields.printedBy: Dana Whitfield, EM Director, Brennan County Emergency Management Agency

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. The EM Director should note the email and set it aside within seconds, and may ask someone to confirm the EOC's WebEOC login still works for state requests later. If anyone spends real time on this while the line approaches around 22:40, raise it in the hot wash.
